description: This file defines the 'Time' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling time calculations and conversions in Excel files, including functions for creating time objects from hours, minutes, and seconds, adjusting time components, and converting to various date/time formats.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class providing static methods for creating and manipulating time objects, primarily for calculations involving Excel time serialization and conversion.

methods.name: fromHMS
methods.description: Creates a time value from hours, minutes, and seconds, supporting array arguments and converting to different date/time formats depending on the configuration.

methods.name: adjustSecond
methods.description: Adjusts seconds and minutes when seconds are outside the 0-59 range, normalizing seconds and adjusting minutes accordingly.

methods.name: adjustMinute
methods.description: Adjusts minutes and hours when minutes are outside the 0-59 range, normalizing minutes and adjusting hours accordingly.

methods.name: toIntWithNullBool
methods.description: Converts a value to integer, handling boolean and null inputs, and throws exception if the value is non-numeric.
